symptom: The UC-13 backend did not reach healthy after MySQL became healthy on the non-conflicting host port.

evidence.primary_error: Migration MakeTransactionsReceiptIdNullable20260901101931 failed because table transactions does not exist.
evidence.database_health: healthy on host port 3307 through a temporary non-repository override
evidence.source_builds: fresh backend and frontend production images both passed

root_cause.summary: The active persistent database baseline lacks the transactions table required by an existing migration that runs before application startup.

actions_attempted: Resolved the host-port conflict with a temporary non-repository override that preserves Compose-internal port 3306.
Started database, backend, and frontend with bounded Compose health waiting.
Captured bounded backend logs and stopped all three services without deleting the persistent volume.
commands_rerun: docker compose -f finalsource/compose.yaml -f /private/tmp/uc13-compose-port-override.yaml stop backend frontend database
resolution: The approved UC-13 recovery path created the missing categories, accounts and transactions prerequisites without seed data or volume reset; MakeTransactionsReceiptIdNullable20260901101931 completed and is recorded in the migrations table.
prevention: Activate a researcher-approved domain schema baseline before migrations that alter the transactions table; do not create or mutate missing domain tables implicitly.
